title: test/system: fix healthcheck since race
body:
I filed #29353 after this test came up as the most frequent failure in the rerun history I have been going through, and the diagnosis came out of the journal artifacts of two failed jobs: the unhealthy event fires 19ms and 60ms before the `--since` timestamp the test captures, so the events window can never contain it. With a 1s interval the third failure can fire while the "First failure" checks are still running.

81fceb48d already moved this capture before the systemctl checks for the same reason, but it still sits after the trigger. This drops it and reuses the timestamp taken before the touch. I think that is safe because the wait loop only matches the last event, and the assertion table already accepts FailingStreak 3-6.

cc @Luap99

comments.body: Thanks, in general it would be good to have the context in the commit message not just the PR description.
